plannedTimeline.title: James Coffee - Vista
plannedTimeline.detail: Main St. Local specialty bakery-café. Daily 7am-4pm. The car stays in the studio's gated spot until lunch.

plannedTimeline.title: Coyote Cafe
plannedTimeline.detail: N Santa Fe Ave, a short roll from the studio. Homestyle breakfast.

plannedTimeline.title: 92084 → Brengle Terrace → home #1
plannedTimeline.detail: No driving: 92084 (more land and space for the money), then the streets around Brengle Terrace and a lap of Brengle Terrace Park - one of Vista's best parks; see what weekend life looks like. Home #1 on the way back. Vista is hilly - low gear and no shame in walking a climb. 🗺️ Bike route

plannedTimeline.title: Studio → Shadowridge · ~10 min
plannedTimeline.detail: Fold, boot, go. Lunch in Shadowridge, then the 1:00 showing is in Carlsbad. Park at Buena Vista Park (1601 Shadowridge Dr, public park lot) for lunch.

plannedTimeline.title: Leucadia Pizzeria - Shadowridge
plannedTimeline.detail: S Melrose Dr, a short roll from the park. Right in the neighbourhood we're circling.

plannedTimeline.title: 6015 Paseo Salinero, Carlsbad
plannedTimeline.detail: First stop. Score view, privacy (no one looking in), and outdoor space.

plannedTimeline.title: 509 Avenida Aguila, San Marcos
plannedTimeline.detail: Last stop. It starts at 2:55, so it runs past 3:20 once you leave San Marcos for Vista. Coffee moves to 3:40.

plannedTimeline.title: Cosmic Bloom Coffee
plannedTimeline.detail: Main St, back downtown after the San Marcos stop. Was 3:15; moved because the last showing is 2:55. Still before 4 PM.

plannedTimeline.title: Trader Joe's - Vista
plannedTimeline.detail: 1861 University Dr. Was 3:45; moved with the coffee. Keep it short - Calavera is at 4:45. Is this the store you'd use every Tuesday? Then home #2 nearby. Alt: Sprouts · E Vista Way.

plannedTimeline.title: Calavera Hills + Lake Calavera
plannedTimeline.detail: Drive ~15 min and park at the Lake Calavera Preserve trailhead. Ride Calavera Hills (newer condos built around trails), then walk the bike on the lake trail.

plannedTimeline.title: Carlsbad Village + seawall
plannedTimeline.detail: Drive ~10 min, park in a Village public lot (check time limits). Roll State St and Grand Ave, then Nick's seawall along Carlsbad Blvd at sunset (~6:30). Walk the bike on the seawall walkway itself. If Vista doesn't make this feel easy, it's the wrong Vista pocket.

plannedTimeline.title: Le Papagayo - Carlsbad Village
plannedTimeline.detail: 112 State St. Alt if full: 264 Fresco.

plannedTimeline.title: Village → Vista · ~15-20 min
plannedTimeline.detail: Car in the gated spot, bike upstairs. 🗺️ Maps drive

plannedTimeline.title: Downtown Vista / Main Street
plannedTimeline.detail: A few minutes' walk from the studio - no driving. Prey Brewing or Belching Beaver Tavern.
